COLDWAR_EC_s5_rat_referendum = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_5 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_5 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_5 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_5 = 60 }
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 5: negotiate an opt-out (180 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s5_rat_optout = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_5 = 5 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_5 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_5 = 180 }
	COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 5: accept the result; the treaty fails.
COLDWAR_EC_s5_rat_defeat = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_5 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s5_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 5.
COLDWAR_EC_s5_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s5_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s5_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_s5_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 8 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s5_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s5_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 9 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_close_nominations = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_project_slot_free = yes }
				COLDWAR_EC_s5_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_EC_s5_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 6 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_slot = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = global.cwec_s6_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_phase = global.cwec_s6_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_stage = global.cwec_s6_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_due = global.cwec_s6_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_issue = global.cwec_s6_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_s6_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_opt = global.cwec_s6_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = global.cwec_s6_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = global.cwec_s6_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_by = global.cwec_s6_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ticket = global.cwec_s6_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ptime = global.cwec_s6_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_since = global.cwec_s6_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_len = global.cwec_s6_len }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 6.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_free = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 6 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s6_target = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_s6_target = { set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 0 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_len = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 6 waits for the Council floor.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ticket = global.cwec_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 6.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s6_due = cwec_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_len = cwec_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 6 with the temp request (cwec_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_EC_s6_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_item = cwec_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target = cwec_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_opt = cwec_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_size = cwec_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ret = cwec_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_by = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_by = THIS.id }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_busy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_pay_request = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwec_s6_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 5 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 6 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_to_queue = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			var:global.cwec_s6_target = { COLDWAR_EC_is_candidate = yes } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 2 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_EC_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwec_t_days
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 6 goes to the Council floor for 30 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_due = global.cwec_s6_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = cwec_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = cwec_t_epm }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_proc = cwec_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_stage = global.cwec_s6_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_item = global.cwec_s6_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_target = global.cwec_s6_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_size = global.cwec_s6_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_opt = global.cwec_s6_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ret = global.cwec_s6_ret }
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 6; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_close = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = cwec_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -2 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			# world news: a veto names the member, a rejection by Parliament gives the seats
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_last_vetoer }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 12 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_sf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_sa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { # qualified majority without the quorum of two votes
					check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 1 }
					check_variable = { cwec_t_nv < 2 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_n = 1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 6 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_passed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s6_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 7 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 4 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 180 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 3 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s6_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 8 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 540 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s6_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 8 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 9 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwec_s6_target = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwec_s6_target = { set_variable = { cwec_ev4_item = global.cwec_s6_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_s6_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 6 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_failed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_rejected = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_stage = 1 } }
		var:global.cwec_s6_target = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_negotiations_refused days = 180 value = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 6 enters into force.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_apply = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s6_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_adopted = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
			COLDWAR_EC_appoint_commission = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.13 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwec_s6_target = { COLDWAR_EC_accession_effective = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_free = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 6 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_EC_s6_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 6 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_decline = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s6_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwec_s6_by = { set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = global.cwec_s6_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_target = global.cwec_s6_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwec_s6_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s6_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s6_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 6: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_6 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = cwec_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwec_ev3_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 6 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_begin = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_item = 61 } }
		var:global.cwec_s6_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_begin = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 6.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_6 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_6 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ratmode_6 = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_referendum_result = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_yes > 49.99 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 3 }
				add_stability = 0.03
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 4 }
				set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwec_ev14_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.14 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 4 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_6 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = 180 }
		COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 5 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_6 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 6; in force one month after the last ratification (accession: 1 January).
COLDWAR_EC_s6_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 0 }
	# the applicant of an accession no longer exists: the treaty closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_item = 61 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s6_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_free = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_item = 61 }
			var:global.cwec_s6_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_s6_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_step = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_item = 61 } }
			var:global.cwec_s6_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 6 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_item = 61 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_next_jan1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = global.num_days }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 6 in the national parliament (90 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_6 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -50
	add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_EC_ratification_debate days = 180 }
}

# Country scope. Hold a referendum on file 6 (60-day campaign).
COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_referendum = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_6 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = 60 }
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 6: negotiate an opt-out (180 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_optout = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 5 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_6 = 180 }
	COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 6: accept the result; the treaty fails.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_rat_defeat = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_6 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s6_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 6.
COLDWAR_EC_s6_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_s6_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 8 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 9 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_close_nominations = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_project_slot_free = yes }
				COLDWAR_EC_s6_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_EC_s6_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 7 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_slot = 7 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = global.cwec_s7_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_phase = global.cwec_s7_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_stage = global.cwec_s7_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_due = global.cwec_s7_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_issue = global.cwec_s7_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_s7_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_opt = global.cwec_s7_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = global.cwec_s7_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = global.cwec_s7_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_by = global.cwec_s7_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ticket = global.cwec_s7_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ptime = global.cwec_s7_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_since = global.cwec_s7_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_len = global.cwec_s7_len }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 7.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_free = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 7 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s7_target = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_s7_target = { set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 0 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_len = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 7 waits for the Council floor.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ticket = global.cwec_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 7.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s7_due = cwec_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_len = cwec_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 7 with the temp request (cwec_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_EC_s7_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_item = cwec_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target = cwec_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_opt = cwec_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_size = cwec_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ret = cwec_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_by = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_by = THIS.id }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_busy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_pay_request = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwec_s7_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 5 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 6 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_to_queue = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			var:global.cwec_s7_target = { COLDWAR_EC_is_candidate = yes } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 2 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_EC_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwec_t_days
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 7 goes to the Council floor for 30 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 7 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_due = global.cwec_s7_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = cwec_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = cwec_t_epm }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_proc = cwec_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_stage = global.cwec_s7_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_item = global.cwec_s7_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_target = global.cwec_s7_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_size = global.cwec_s7_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_opt = global.cwec_s7_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ret = global.cwec_s7_ret }
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 7; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_close = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = cwec_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -2 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			# world news: a veto names the member, a rejection by Parliament gives the seats
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_last_vetoer }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 12 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_sf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_sa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { # qualified majority without the quorum of two votes
					check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 1 }
					check_variable = { cwec_t_nv < 2 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_n = 1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 7 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_passed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s7_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 7 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 4 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 180 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 3 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s7_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 8 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 540 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s7_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 8 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 9 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwec_s7_target = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwec_s7_target = { set_variable = { cwec_ev4_item = global.cwec_s7_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_s7_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 7 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_failed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_rejected = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_stage = 1 } }
		var:global.cwec_s7_target = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_negotiations_refused days = 180 value = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 7 enters into force.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_apply = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s7_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_adopted = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
			COLDWAR_EC_appoint_commission = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.13 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwec_s7_target = { COLDWAR_EC_accession_effective = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_free = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 7 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_EC_s7_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 7 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_decline = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s7_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwec_s7_by = { set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = global.cwec_s7_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_target = global.cwec_s7_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwec_s7_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s7_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s7_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 7: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_7 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = cwec_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwec_ev3_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 7 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_begin = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_item = 61 } }
		var:global.cwec_s7_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_begin = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 7.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_7 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_7 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ratmode_7 = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_referendum_result = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_yes > 49.99 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 3 }
				add_stability = 0.03
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 4 }
				set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwec_ev14_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.14 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 4 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_7 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = 180 }
		COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 5 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_7 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 7; in force one month after the last ratification (accession: 1 January).
COLDWAR_EC_s7_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 0 }
	# the applicant of an accession no longer exists: the treaty closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_item = 61 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s7_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_free = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_item = 61 }
			var:global.cwec_s7_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_s7_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_step = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_item = 61 } }
			var:global.cwec_s7_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 6 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_item = 61 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_next_jan1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = global.num_days }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 7 in the national parliament (90 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_7 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -50
	add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_EC_ratification_debate days = 180 }
}

# Country scope. Hold a referendum on file 7 (60-day campaign).
COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_referendum = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_7 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = 60 }
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 7: negotiate an opt-out (180 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_optout = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 5 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_7 = 180 }
	COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 7: accept the result; the treaty fails.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_rat_defeat = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_7 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s7_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 7.
COLDWAR_EC_s7_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_s7_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 8 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 9 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_close_nominations = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_project_slot_free = yes }
				COLDWAR_EC_s7_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_EC_s7_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 8 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_slot = 8 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = global.cwec_s8_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_phase = global.cwec_s8_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_stage = global.cwec_s8_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_due = global.cwec_s8_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_issue = global.cwec_s8_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_s8_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_opt = global.cwec_s8_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = global.cwec_s8_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = global.cwec_s8_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_by = global.cwec_s8_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ticket = global.cwec_s8_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ptime = global.cwec_s8_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_since = global.cwec_s8_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_len = global.cwec_s8_len }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 8.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_free = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 8 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s8_target = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_s8_target = { set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 0 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_len = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 8 waits for the Council floor.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ticket = global.cwec_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 8.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s8_due = cwec_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_len = cwec_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 8 with the temp request (cwec_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_EC_s8_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_item = cwec_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target = cwec_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_opt = cwec_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_size = cwec_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ret = cwec_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_by = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_by = THIS.id }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_busy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_pay_request = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwec_s8_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 5 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 6 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_to_queue = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			var:global.cwec_s8_target = { COLDWAR_EC_is_candidate = yes } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 2 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_EC_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwec_t_days
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 8 goes to the Council floor for 30 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 8 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_due = global.cwec_s8_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = cwec_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = cwec_t_epm }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_proc = cwec_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_stage = global.cwec_s8_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_item = global.cwec_s8_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_target = global.cwec_s8_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_size = global.cwec_s8_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_opt = global.cwec_s8_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ret = global.cwec_s8_ret }
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 8; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_close = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = cwec_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -2 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			# world news: a veto names the member, a rejection by Parliament gives the seats
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_last_vetoer }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 12 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_sf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_sa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { # qualified majority without the quorum of two votes
					check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 1 }
					check_variable = { cwec_t_nv < 2 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_n = 1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 8 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_passed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s8_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 7 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 4 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 180 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 3 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s8_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 8 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 540 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
