				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s8_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 8 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 9 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwec_s8_target = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwec_s8_target = { set_variable = { cwec_ev4_item = global.cwec_s8_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_s8_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 8 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_failed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_rejected = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_stage = 1 } }
		var:global.cwec_s8_target = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_negotiations_refused days = 180 value = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 8 enters into force.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_apply = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s8_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_adopted = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
			COLDWAR_EC_appoint_commission = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.13 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwec_s8_target = { COLDWAR_EC_accession_effective = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_free = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 8 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_EC_s8_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 8 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_decline = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s8_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwec_s8_by = { set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = global.cwec_s8_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_target = global.cwec_s8_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwec_s8_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s8_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s8_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 8: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_8 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = cwec_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwec_ev3_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 8 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_begin = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_item = 61 } }
		var:global.cwec_s8_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_begin = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 8.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_8 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_8 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ratmode_8 = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_referendum_result = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_yes > 49.99 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 3 }
				add_stability = 0.03
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 4 }
				set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwec_ev14_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.14 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 4 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_8 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = 180 }
		COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 5 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_8 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 8; in force one month after the last ratification (accession: 1 January).
COLDWAR_EC_s8_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 0 }
	# the applicant of an accession no longer exists: the treaty closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_item = 61 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s8_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_free = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_item = 61 }
			var:global.cwec_s8_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_s8_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_step = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_item = 61 } }
			var:global.cwec_s8_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 6 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_item = 61 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_next_jan1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = global.num_days }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 8 in the national parliament (90 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_8 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -50
	add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_EC_ratification_debate days = 180 }
}

# Country scope. Hold a referendum on file 8 (60-day campaign).
COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_referendum = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_8 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = 60 }
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 8: negotiate an opt-out (180 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_optout = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 5 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_8 = 180 }
	COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 8: accept the result; the treaty fails.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_rat_defeat = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_8 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s8_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 8.
COLDWAR_EC_s8_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_s8_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 8 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 9 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_close_nominations = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_project_slot_free = yes }
				COLDWAR_EC_s8_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_EC_s8_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 9 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_slot = 9 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = global.cwec_s9_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_phase = global.cwec_s9_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_stage = global.cwec_s9_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_due = global.cwec_s9_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_issue = global.cwec_s9_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_s9_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_opt = global.cwec_s9_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = global.cwec_s9_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = global.cwec_s9_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_by = global.cwec_s9_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ticket = global.cwec_s9_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ptime = global.cwec_s9_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_since = global.cwec_s9_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_len = global.cwec_s9_len }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 9.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_free = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 9 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s9_target = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_s9_target = { set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 0 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_len = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 9 waits for the Council floor.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ticket = global.cwec_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 9.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s9_due = cwec_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_len = cwec_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 9 with the temp request (cwec_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_EC_s9_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = cwec_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target = cwec_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_opt = cwec_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_size = cwec_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ret = cwec_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_by = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_by = THIS.id }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_busy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_pay_request = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwec_s9_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 5 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 6 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_to_queue = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			var:global.cwec_s9_target = { COLDWAR_EC_is_candidate = yes } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 2 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_EC_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwec_t_days
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 9 goes to the Council floor for 30 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 9 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_due = global.cwec_s9_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = cwec_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = cwec_t_epm }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_proc = cwec_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_stage = global.cwec_s9_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_item = global.cwec_s9_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_target = global.cwec_s9_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_size = global.cwec_s9_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_opt = global.cwec_s9_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ret = global.cwec_s9_ret }
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 9; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_close = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = cwec_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -2 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			# world news: a veto names the member, a rejection by Parliament gives the seats
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_last_vetoer }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 12 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_sf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_sa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { # qualified majority without the quorum of two votes
					check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 1 }
					check_variable = { cwec_t_nv < 2 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_n = 1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 9 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_passed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s9_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 7 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 4 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 180 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 3 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s9_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 8 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 540 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s9_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 8 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 9 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwec_s9_target = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwec_s9_target = { set_variable = { cwec_ev4_item = global.cwec_s9_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_s9_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 9 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_failed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_rejected = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 1 } }
		var:global.cwec_s9_target = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_negotiations_refused days = 180 value = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 9 enters into force.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_apply = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s9_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_adopted = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
			COLDWAR_EC_appoint_commission = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.13 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwec_s9_target = { COLDWAR_EC_accession_effective = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_free = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 9 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_EC_s9_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 9 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_decline = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s9_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwec_s9_by = { set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = global.cwec_s9_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_target = global.cwec_s9_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwec_s9_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s9_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s9_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 9: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_9 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = cwec_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwec_ev3_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 9 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_begin = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 61 } }
		var:global.cwec_s9_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_begin = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 9.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_9 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_9 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ratmode_9 = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_referendum_result = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_yes > 49.99 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 3 }
				add_stability = 0.03
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 4 }
				set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwec_ev14_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.14 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 4 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_9 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = 180 }
		COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 5 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_9 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 9; in force one month after the last ratification (accession: 1 January).
COLDWAR_EC_s9_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 0 }
	# the applicant of an accession no longer exists: the treaty closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 61 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s9_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_free = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 61 }
			var:global.cwec_s9_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_s9_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_step = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 61 } }
			var:global.cwec_s9_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 6 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 61 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_next_jan1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = global.num_days }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 9 in the national parliament (90 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_9 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -50
	add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_EC_ratification_debate days = 180 }
}

# Country scope. Hold a referendum on file 9 (60-day campaign).
COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_referendum = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_9 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = 60 }
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 9: negotiate an opt-out (180 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_optout = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 5 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_9 = 180 }
	COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 9: accept the result; the treaty fails.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_rat_defeat = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s9_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 9.
COLDWAR_EC_s9_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_s9_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 8 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 9 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_close_nominations = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_project_slot_free = yes }
				COLDWAR_EC_s9_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_EC_s9_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 10 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_slot = 10 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = global.cwec_s10_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_phase = global.cwec_s10_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_stage = global.cwec_s10_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_due = global.cwec_s10_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_issue = global.cwec_s10_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_s10_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_opt = global.cwec_s10_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = global.cwec_s10_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = global.cwec_s10_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_by = global.cwec_s10_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ticket = global.cwec_s10_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ptime = global.cwec_s10_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_since = global.cwec_s10_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_len = global.cwec_s10_len }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 10.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 10 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s10_target = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_s10_target = { set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 0 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_len = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 10 waits for the Council floor.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ticket = global.cwec_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 10.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s10_due = cwec_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_len = cwec_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 10 with the temp request (cwec_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_EC_s10_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = cwec_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target = cwec_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_opt = cwec_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_size = cwec_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ret = cwec_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_by = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_by = THIS.id }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_busy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_commission = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_pay_request = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwec_s10_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 5 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 6 } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_to_queue = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			var:global.cwec_s10_target = { COLDWAR_EC_is_candidate = yes } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 2 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_EC_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwec_t_days
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. File 10 goes to the Council floor for 30 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 10 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_issue = global.cwec_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_due = global.cwec_s10_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = cwec_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = cwec_t_epm }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_proc = cwec_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_stage = global.cwec_s10_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_item = global.cwec_s10_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_target = global.cwec_s10_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_size = global.cwec_s10_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_opt = global.cwec_s10_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ret = global.cwec_s10_ret }
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev1_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 10; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_close = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = cwec_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_record_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -2 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			# world news: a veto names the member, a rejection by Parliament gives the seats
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_last_vetoer }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 12 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_sf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_sa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { # qualified majority without the quorum of two votes
					check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 1 }
					check_variable = { cwec_t_nv < 2 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_n = 1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 10 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_passed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s10_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 7 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 4 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 180 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 3 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s10_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 8 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 540 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwec_s10_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 8 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 9 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwec_s10_target = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwec_s10_target = { set_variable = { cwec_ev4_item = global.cwec_s10_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
					COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_s10_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
				COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 10 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_failed = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_rejected = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 1 } }
		var:global.cwec_s10_target = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_negotiations_refused days = 180 value = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 10 enters into force.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_apply = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ctx_props = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s10_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 12 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_adopted = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 13 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
			COLDWAR_EC_appoint_commission = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev13_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.13 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwec_s10_target = { COLDWAR_EC_accession_effective = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 10 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_EC_s10_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 10 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_decline = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_s10_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwec_s10_by = { set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = global.cwec_s10_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_target = global.cwec_s10_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwec_s10_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s10_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_s10_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 10: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_10 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = cwec_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwec_ev3_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 10 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_begin = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 61 } }
		var:global.cwec_s10_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_begin = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 10.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_10 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_10 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ratmode_10 = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_referendum_result = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_yes > 49.99 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 3 }
				add_stability = 0.03
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 }
				COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 4 }
				set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = 90 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwec_ev14_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.14 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 4 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_10 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = 180 }
		COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 5 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_ratdue_10 } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 10; in force one month after the last ratification (accession: 1 January).
COLDWAR_EC_s10_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 0 }
	# the applicant of an accession no longer exists: the treaty closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 61 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwec_s10_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 16 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_all = 0 }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 61 }
			var:global.cwec_s10_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_s10_target = { COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_step = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = global.cwec_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 61 } }
			var:global.cwec_s10_target = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 6 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 61 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_next_jan1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = cwec_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = global.num_days }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_EC_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_item = global.cwec_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_a = global.cwec_last_wf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_b = global.cwec_last_w }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_c = global.cwec_last_wa }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n_d = global.cwec_last_res }
			COLDWAR_EC_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_res = global.cwec_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwec_ev2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 10 in the national parliament (90 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_10 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -50
	add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_EC_ratification_debate days = 180 }
}

# Country scope. Hold a referendum on file 10 (60-day campaign).
COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_referendum = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratmode_10 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = 60 }
}

# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 10: negotiate an opt-out (180 days).
COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_optout = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 5 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ratdue_10 = 180 }
	COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = yes
}
