# Country scope. After a lost referendum on file 10: accept the result; the treaty fails.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_rat_defeat = {
	set_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_EC_s10_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 10.
COLDWAR_EC_s10_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_s10_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 8 } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 9 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_close_nominations = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_EC_project_slot_free = yes }
				COLDWAR_EC_s10_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_EC_s10_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Deadlines of every open file.
COLDWAR_EC_slots_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s1_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s2_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s3_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s4_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s5_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_tick = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Closes a vote at its deadline and opens the next one.
COLDWAR_EC_floor_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_floor_due } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_close_vote = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. Closes the vote on the floor.
COLDWAR_EC_close_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s1_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s2_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s3_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s4_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s5_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 8 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 9 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_close = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The Council debates one file at a time, in the order of the agenda (lowest ticket first).
COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
			COLDWAR_EC_any_player_member = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 999999 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s1_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s2_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s3_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s4_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s5_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s6_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s7_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s8_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s9_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 9 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ticket < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = global.cwec_s10_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s1_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s2_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 3 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s3_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s4_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 5 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s5_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 7 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 8 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 9 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s9_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bests = 10 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s10_open_vote = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Counts only members governed by players: Council weights against 70.5 %, unanimity (no Against) or simple majority; quorum of two votes; Parliament by seated delegations. temp cwec_t_res: 0 no players, 1 adopted, 2 rejected, 3 vital interest, 4 rejected by Parliament, 5 no assent, 6 adopted against the opinion of Parliament.
COLDWAR_EC_tally = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_wf = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_wa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_nv = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_nf = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_na = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_vital = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p5veto = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_n = 1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = cwec_weight }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = cwec_seats }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gv = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_vote_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_nv = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gv = cwec_vote }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_gv = 1 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_wf = cwec_weight }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_nf = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_gv = 2 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_wa = cwec_weight }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_na = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_vital_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_vital = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ev = cwec_t_gv }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_epv_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue }
					check_variable = { cwec_epv > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ev = cwec_epv }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_ev = 1 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = cwec_seats }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_ev = 2 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sa = cwec_seats }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 105 }
					OR = { original_tag = FRA original_tag = ENG }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_gv = 1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p5veto = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# qualified majority: 70.5 % of the seated players, rounded up
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_q = cwec_t_w }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_q = 0.705 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_q = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwec_t_q
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_wf < cwec_t_q } }
				OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_nv > 1 } check_variable = { cwec_t_n = 1 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_na = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_nf > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_thr = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_nf2 = cwec_t_nf }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_nf2 = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_nf2 > cwec_t_n } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_vital = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_p5veto = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 0 }
	}
	# Parliament (an opinion on the budget counts like a consultation)
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sa2 = cwec_t_sa }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sa2 = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf2 = cwec_t_sf }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf2 = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_ok = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 5 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_sa > cwec_t_sf } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_sa2 > cwec_t_s }
					OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_na = 0 } } check_variable = { cwec_t_nf = 0 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_sa2 > cwec_t_s } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 4 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_sf2 > cwec_t_s } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 6 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sa3 = cwec_t_sa }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sa3 = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cast = cwec_t_sf }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cast = cwec_t_sa }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cast = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_sa2 > cwec_t_s }
					NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_sa3 < cwec_t_cast } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_sf > cwec_t_sa } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_n = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 }
	}
	# results kept for the window and the news
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_n = cwec_t_n }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_w = cwec_t_w }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_wf = cwec_t_wf }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_wa = cwec_t_wa }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_q = cwec_t_q }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_sf = cwec_t_sf }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_sa = cwec_t_sa }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_s = cwec_t_s }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_res = cwec_t_res }
}

# Any scope. When every seated player has voted, the vote closes at once.
COLDWAR_EC_check_all_voted = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor > 0 }
			all_of_scopes = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				OR = { is_ai = yes check_variable = { cwec_vote_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_EC_close_vote = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). temp cwec_t_v: 1 For, 2 Against, 3 Abstain. A vote can be changed until the vote closes.
COLDWAR_EC_cast_vote = {
	set_variable = { cwec_vote = cwec_t_v }
	set_variable = { cwec_vote_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue }
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_check_all_voted = yes
}

# Country scope (player member). temp cwec_t_v: delegation vote (0 follows the government).
COLDWAR_EC_cast_ep_vote = {
	set_variable = { cwec_epv = cwec_t_v }
	set_variable = { cwec_epv_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue }
}

# Country scope. temp cwec_t_cost: political power for the Luxembourg compromise (75; 200 after the Single Act; doubled by A5, by a second use within a year and for the presidency or the Commission president; free in a Union of States).
COLDWAR_EC_vital_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_lux_free }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cost = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_lux_200 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cost = 200 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cost = 75 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_lux_double }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cost = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_vital_used }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cost = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_pres = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwec_com = THIS.id } } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cost = 2 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). Luxembourg compromise: the own Against blocks a qualified-majority decision.
COLDWAR_EC_invoke_vital = {
	COLDWAR_EC_vital_cost = yes
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cost = -1 }
	add_political_power = cwec_t_cost
	set_variable = { cwec_vote = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwec_vote_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue }
	set_variable = { cwec_vital_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue }
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_vital_used days = 365 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_last_vetoer = THIS.id }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_vital_interest } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_check_all_voted = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_load: Commission workload, +15 % per procedure beyond three (at most +60 %).
COLDWAR_EC_workload = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 4 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 8 } check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_act = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_load = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_act > 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_act }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = -3 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.15 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_load = cwec_t_x }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_load max = 1.6 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Pays the request: Commission request, treaty proposal or tabling (the presidency has one free tabling per term after A2).
COLDWAR_EC_pay_request = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pay = cwec_t_cost }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 6 }
			has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_epc_half }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pay = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_pres_free
			NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_pres_free_used }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_pres = THIS.id }
			OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 5 } check_variable = { cwec_t_proc = 6 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pay = 0 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_pres_free_used
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pay = -1 }
	add_political_power = cwec_t_pay
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_slot: first free request file (0 = the Commission desk is full).
COLDWAR_EC_find_slot = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 8 }
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). Opens a file for the request in temp cwec_t_item, cwec_t_target, cwec_t_opt, cwec_t_size, cwec_t_ret.
COLDWAR_EC_request = {
	COLDWAR_EC_find_slot = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s1_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s2_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s3_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s4_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s5_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s6_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s7_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 8 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s8_open = yes
	}
	# COLDWAR 22.11.2026: every other player member learns at once that a proposal is on the agenda (playtest 1: the USSR got no notice)
	save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_EC_agenda_by
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { tag = event_target:COLDWAR_EC_agenda_by } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.41 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
}

# Country scope. temp cwec_t_yes: share of Yes votes = support for Europe +/- 6.
COLDWAR_EC_referendum_result = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_yes = cwec_support }
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = cwec_t_rnd min = -6 max = 6 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_yes = cwec_t_rnd }
	set_variable = { cwec_last_referendum = cwec_t_yes }
}

# Country scope. Edinburgh 1992: an opt-out from the single currency and the social charter, support +8.
COLDWAR_EC_take_optout = {
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_optout
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 8 }
	COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
}

# Country scope (President of the Commission, a player). temp cwec_t_slot: declines to table a requested draft.
COLDWAR_EC_decline_draft = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s1_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_s1_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwec_s1_by = { set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = global.cwec_s1_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_s1_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s2_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_s2_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwec_s2_by = { set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = global.cwec_s2_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 } }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_s3_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {

	if = {

		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {

# Any scope. Weekly: while the Presidency of the Commission is governed by the AI, every requested draft is tabled at once, so the players can always vote (23.11.2026).
COLDWAR_EC_ai_office_tables = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_com > 0 } var:global.cwec_com = { exists = yes is_ai = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s1_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s2_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s3_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s4_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s5_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s6_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s7_to_queue = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_s8_to_queue = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_slot: the presidency puts a file first on the agenda (once per term).
COLDWAR_EC_bring_forward = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s1_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s2_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 3 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s3_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 4 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s4_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 5 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s5_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 6 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s6_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 7 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s7_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 8 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s8_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 9 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_slot = 10 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ticket = 0 }
	}
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_pres_forward_used
	COLDWAR_EC_try_open_vote = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
}

# Any scope. temp <V>t_n_*: one world news for every player (queued: one news at a time, each with its own values).
COLDWAR_EC_news = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_item = cwec_t_n_item }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_res = cwec_t_n_res }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_target = cwec_t_n_target }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_by = cwec_t_n_by }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_who = cwec_t_n_who }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_a = cwec_t_n_a }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_b = cwec_t_n_b }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_c = cwec_t_n_c }
		add_to_array = { cwec_nq_d = cwec_t_n_d }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_news_busy } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_news_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
			news_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.30 }
		}
	}
}
